svg.title: Write a plugin in three commands
svg.desc: Three CLI steps: corvin plugin types lists the 13 surfaces and whether each is called; corvin plugin new scaffolds from the shipped template; corvin plugin check validates against the real registry rules; then install it from the local directory.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
